What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
Once an order has shipped, changes are no longer mentioned as possible in our guidelines. All updates—like rescheduling, changing meals, extras, address, or pet details—need to be made before your order deadline shown on your Plan page under “Make changes by…”. After that deadline passes, the order is placed and charged as-is.
